bio.text: Gabe Vasquez was elected to represent New Mexico's 2nd Congressional District in November 2022 and is serving his second term.
He was elected to the Las Cruces City Council in 2017.
Earlier he worked on U.S. Senator Martin Heinrich's staff beginning in 2013 and was executive director of the Las Cruces Hispano Chamber of Commerce.
His office describes him as a first-generation Mexican-American who grew up in the borderlands.
